decision.risk_assessment: Weak trend strength with ADX under 20 on both pairs, low volume, and overbought short-term indicators near upper Bollinger Bands.
decision.reasoning: Both BTC and ETH exhibit weak ADX readings (18.5 and 17.7) despite bullish EMA alignments.
